decision: Separate aggregate gate, new original-closing-hour diagnostic gates, and same-schedule H benefit. Protected candidate requires all three; not a claim of global optimality or simultaneous confidence coverage.
primary_contrast: shift30_A20 minus peak_A20, evaluated separately under each prespecified synthetic scenario
proxy_role: Exploratory transaction-time shape stress only. Sum count / sum exposure by relative hour, normalize to assumed 540 alerts/day; fixed phases 0 and +12 hours. Risk and service marks remain synthetic. No absolute bank clock is known.
pairing: Common base alert arrival order, daily counts, risk and service realizations across scenarios and plans within a replication. Monotone cumulative-intensity mapping changes arrival timing only; independent replication seeds.
inference: Pointwise two-sided Student 95% intervals across 100 independent replication statistics or paired differences; not input-uncertainty or simultaneous confidence intervals. No optional stopping or search over staffing windows.
labor: Three permanent seats contribute 72 seat-h/day. Scheduled fourth-seat coverage includes idle time, plus actual nonpreemptive work outside all its scheduled windows. Window-clipped paid seat-hours, no wages or employee counts.
